_note: The board's own title is the adjudication: 'Layers · component-instance —
NOT A STATE — a per-row badge gated on composer.components.isInstance
(LayerTreeItem.tsx:115,256-264)'. It was corrected to the code, and the
badge ships. Reaching it in the demo would take a saved component and a
placed instance of it, so the probe mounts the real LayerTreeItem with the
one composer call it makes — `isInstance` — true for the child row.
The row renders its own children, so the case mounts the ROOT only.
The indent ladder is verified by the measurement: root at 12, child at 28,
which is 1082:4748's pl-12 and 1082:4754's pl-28 exactly (the code derives
it as 12 + depth*16 from board 1082:4640).
JOINED: the two row labels (1082:4751, 1082:4756) — 13px, `normal` line
box, --color/ink. That is the row type contract and the code matches it.
NOT JOINED, with reasons:
instance-badge (1082:4757) — the board draws the diamond at 10px with no
colour of its own. The code renders it at --bk-text-11 in --bk-success.
10px is BELOW the token scale: --bk-text-11 is the smallest chrome text
token there is, and the badge is the only thing in the tree that says a
row follows a component, so shrinking it under the scale to match a
frame is the wrong trade. The colour is already recorded in code:
'Board badge colors are off-palette for chrome, so the token stands in.'
the rows (1082:4748 / 1082:4754) — two properties disagree.
gap: this board says 6px. The Layers rows drawn on 642:3112
(2143:21047 onward) say 8px AS A TOKEN, --spacing/8. A token
reference is a stronger statement of intent than a bare 6, and the
code is on 8, so the token reading holds.
padding-y: the board says 4. `.bdc-lr` fixes the row at 28px and
centres its children, so 4px of vertical padding would move nothing
on screen; adding it to make a number match would be fitting the
code to the instrument.
eye and lock (1082:4758 / 1082:4759) — drawn as 10px --color/ink-
placeholder glyphs. They ship as real buttons in --bk-ink-muted, and
layers-v2.css records why: '142:2: legible at rest. gray-300 was 1.47:1;
1.4.11 wants 3.' Founder a11y call, unchanged. It is also the whole
cause of the badge x-offset boards.json records (219 live vs 229 on the
board): buttons occupy more of the row's right edge than glyphs do. The
2026-09-02 re-measure at 280 confirmed the gap does not close with width.
the panel header (2100:10968) — drawn 14px semibold ink here, from the
'Panel header' component 2100:11651 that was widened 2026-09-05. The
shipped drawer header is 11px ink-soft, measured on 148:2 and asserted
by components-library against 641:2547 in this same run. Two component
versions in one file; not this surface's call, and not mounted here.
